# Bug: when invoicing is disabled, changing order status to "paid=1" does not register any payment on the order

With **invoicing disabled**, when changing the status of an order to a status that has the **paid = 1** flag (e.g. *Payment accepted*), the system **does not register the payment**.

As a result, on the order detail page, in the **Payment** section, no payment entry is displayed for the order.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65a59774-3791-4bff-9130-e7837a50570b

## Étapes
1. Go to **Orders > Invoices**
2. Set **"Enable invoices" = NO**
3. Create an order selecting **Bank wire** as the payment method
4. Open the order and change its status to **"Payment accepted"**
5. In the **Payments** section of the order, no payment is displayed, whereas with invoicing enabled a payment entry would be added
